Neha (Finance): FYI vendor invoice #501122 arrived late for March services. Amount: $31,412.59. Service period 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31. Need decision: prior-period adj to March or accrue in April? @Sam (Audit) @Devon (Billing)

invoice-bot: Invoice #501122: https://invoices.redwood.local/501122. Invoice date 2026-04-04. Amount $31,412.59. Attached PDF.

Devon (Billing): ETL backfill - bulk is one customer (SEED-9) $27,900.12, rest misc. No duplicates. CSV fragment: SEED-9,2026-03-29,12_300_000,$27_900.12; POOL-5,2026-03-30,1_200_000,$3,512.47.

Jon (RevenueOps): Matching principle -> prior-period adj to March preferred. Draft JE: 2026-03-31 Dr AR 31,412.59 / Cr Deferred Revenue 31,412.59. Link invoice to deferral line.

Sam (Audit): Agrees with prior-period adj if we include memo, invoice, and ETL logs. Also confirm immateriality for quarter metrics.

Marco (Sales Ops): Note SEED-9 has a retro pricing credit of $2,100 tied to a pilot. Sales want the credit applied on April invoice. Recommend we record gross in March and post Customer Credit Liability $2,100.

Neha (Finance): OK let's do gross into March deferrals + record Customer Credit Liability for $2,100. I'll draft the memo and circulate for approvals (EOD target).

Devon (Billing): Will prepare JE and April credit memo draft after approvals.

Jon (RevenueOps): I'll update the revenue schedule and add a close checklist item to catch late ETL runs earlier.

Sam (Audit): Approved approach. Please route memo to audit@redwood.com and cc finance.

Neha (Finance): Thanks all. Posting memo link here when ready and will close thread.
